notes: Book is entirely growth-falling bonds; adding a stock sleeve and a commodity sleeve on confirmed strength to balance quadrant risk, stops as the only mechanical exit.

rule_cited: The Four Quadrants (growth-rising, inflation-falling sleeve) + Diversification is the holy grail
teach: A portfolio balanced across rising and falling growth survives being wrong about which one happens.
why: My whole book is bonds that win when growth falls, so I only add broad stocks after they show real strength, not before.

rule_cited: The Four Quadrants (growth-rising, inflation-rising sleeve) + Diversification is the holy grail
teach: Owning something that wins when inflation rises protects you when your inflation-falling bonds get hurt instead.
why: Commodities just dropped a lot, so I wait for a bounce before adding this inflation hedge my book is currently missing.
